headline: Public hearings on housing and building requests, including ±255 units at 195 Mill Street and townhouses at 18 Crown Street.
summary: Ten public hearings are listed, covering homes, apartments, a garage, and a gas station expansion. Also on the agenda are an appeal about 9 Longworth Road and a time extension request for 137 Hope Ave.
items: Gas station, drive-thru, and retail expansion at 167-177 Southwest Cutoff
Townhouses at 14-18 Kiara Drive, with lot line changes
Conversion of 209 Lincoln Street into a 5-unit residential structure
Seven multi-family buildings at 195 Mill Street
Appeal of building permit plans at 9 Longworth Road
Three high-rise apartment buildings at 1 & 3 Suburban Road
Six-month time extension for 137 Hope Ave (Lot #18)
Board policies and procedures, including upcoming meeting quorum and training opportunities
location: Worcester City Hall, Levi Lincoln Chamber, 3rd Floor (Room 309), 455 Main Street

This Worcester Zoning Board of Appeals meeting will be held in-person at the 
date, time and location listed above. Meeting attendees will additionally have 
options to participate remotely by joining online or by phone below.  
 
• Use the following link to join the meeting via computer: 
https://worcesterma.zoomgov.com/j/1604564634

• If you join the meeting by phone, you can raise your hand by dialing *9 and

Note: If technological problems interrupt the virtual meeting component, the 
meeting will continue in-person.

Old Business – Public Hearings 
 
1. 167-177 Southwest Cutoff (ZB-2026-094)  
Special Permit: To allow a food service (drive-thru) use in an MG-2.0 zone (Article IV, Section 2, Table 4.1, 
Business Uses #6) 
Special Permit: To allow an automobile refueling station use in an MG-2.0 zone (Article IV, Section 2, Table 
4.1, Business Uses #17) 
Special Permit: To allow a retail sales use in an MG-2.0 zone (Article IV, Section 2, Table 4.1, Business Uses 
#26) 
Special Permit: To modify the parking dimensional, layout, and/or landscaping requirements, loading 
requirements, and/or the number of required parking spaces (Article IV, Section 7.A.2.) 
Petitioner: 167 Southwest Cutoff, LLC and Wister Realty Corp. 
Present Use: Presently on the premises at 167 Southwest Cutoff is a ±11,710 SF commercial building with a 
parking area.  Presently on the premises at 177 Southwest Cutoff is a gas station with a fuel 
canopy, a convenience store with a food service/drive -through, and surface parking. 
Zone Designation MG-2.0 (Manufacturing, General) 
Petition Purpose: The applicant seeks to expand the gas station use onto the 167 Southwest Cutoff property, and 
at 177 Southwest Cutoff expand the existing building, relocate the existing drive-through 
window, and expand the existing parking area. 
Testimony Date 10/19/2026 Constructive Grant Deadline: 12/22/2026 
 
 
New Business – Public Hearings 
 
2. 34 Boardman Street (ZB-2026-066) 
Special Permit: To modify the parking dimensional, layout, and/or landscaping requirements, loading 
requirements, and/or the number of required parking spaces (Article IV, Section 7.A.2.) 
Petitioner: Abisola Akande 
Present Use: Presently on the premises is a two-family dwelling.  
Zone Designation RG-5 (Residence, General) 
Petition Purpose: The applicant seeks retroactive approval to cure zoning non-conformities related to paving. 
Public Hearing 
Deadline 
01/05/27 Constructive Grant Deadline: TBD 
 
 
3. 14-18 Kiara Drive (ZB-2026-071) 
Variance: For relief from the minimum frontage requirements for a single-family attached dwelling in 
an RL-7 zone (Article IV, Section 4, Table 4.2)  
Special Permit: To allow a single-family attached use in the RL-7 zone. (Article IV, Section 4, Table 4.1, 
Residential Use #12) 
Petitioner: CLEB, LLC 
Present Use: Presently on the premises are three vacant partially wooded lots. 
Zone Designation: RL-7 (Residence, Limited) 
Petition Purpose: The applicant seeks to redraw lot lines and construct two single-family attached (townhouse) 
structures with a total of ±11 dwelling units with associated parking spaces. 
Public Hearing 
Deadline: 
12/24/2026 Constructive Grant Deadline: 1/28/2027
3 
 
 
4. 209 Lincoln Street (ZB-2026-099) 
Variance: For relief from the minimum parking requirements for an other residential permitted use in the 
RG-5 zone (Article IV, Section 7, Table 4.4)  
Special Permit: To allow a residential conversion from a two-family dwelling to an other residential permitted 
use in the RG-5 zone (Article IV, Section 9)  
Special Permit: To modify the parking dimensional, layout, and/or landscaping requirements, loading 
requirements, and/or the number of required parking spaces (Article IV, Section 7.A.2.) 
Petitioner: Rafael Hernandez  
Present Use: Presently on the premises is a two-family dwelling and detached garage. 
Zone Designation: RG-5 (Residence, General) 
Petition Purpose: The applicant seeks to convert the existing two-family dwelling into a 5-unit residential 
structure with associated parking and site improvements. 
Public Hearing 
Deadline: 
12/24/2026 Constructive Grant Deadline: 1/28/2027 
 
 
5. 195 Mill Street (ZB-2026-100)  
Special Permit: To modify the parking dimensional, layout, and/or landscaping requirements, loading 
requirements, and/or the number of required parking spaces (Article IV, Section 7.A.2.) 
Variance: For relief from the maximum height requirement for an accessory structure (Article IV, 
Section 8.B.10) 
Variance: For relief of the minimum recreational space required for new residential uses in a BG-2.0 
zone (Article IV, Section 4, Table 4.2, Superscript 3). 
Variance: For relief from the minimum parking requirements for a multi-family dwelling use in the BG-
2.0 zone. (Article IV, Section 7, Table 4.4) 
Petitioner: Worcester Mill LLC 
Present Use: Presently on the premises is a concrete slab from the razed former structure, abandoned surface 
parking pavement, and wooded areas. The property is located in the BG-2.0 (Business, General) 
zoning district and partially in the Floodplain Overlay District.  
Zone Designation BG-2.0 (Business, Office); Floodplain Overlay District  
Petition Purpose: The applicant proposes to construct 7 multi-family dwellings with a total of ±255 units, ±389 
parking spaces, and associated site improvements. 
Public Hearing 
Deadline 
01/03/2027 Constructive Grant Deadline: 02/07/2027 
 
 
6. 18 Crown Street (ZB-2026-102)  
Special Permit To modify the parking dimensional, layout, and/or landscaping requirements, loading 
requirements, and/or the number of required parking spaces (Article IV, Section 7.A.2.) 
Petitioner: 39 Worcester, LLC  
Present Use: Presently on the premises is a vacant lot. 
Zone Designation: RG-5 (Residence, General) zoning district and within the Crown Hill Local Historic District 
Petition Purpose: The applicant seeks to construct four single-family attached (townhouse) dwellings with 
parking and associated site improvements. 
Public Hearing 
Deadline: 
12/23/2026 Constructive Grant Deadline: TBD
4 
 
 
 
 
7. 9 Longworth Road (ZB-2026-106) 
Administrative 
Appeal: 
Of a determination issued by the Building Commissioner finding that the submitted plans 
associated with a building permit for 9 Longworth Road are in substantial accordance with the 
approval granted by the Zoning Board of Appeals. 
Petitioner: Keith Boucher 
Present Use: Presently on the premises is a partially constructed single-family detached dwelling, previously approved per ZB-2025-052.  
Zone Designation RS-7 (Residential, Single-Family) 
Petition Purpose: 
The applicant seeks to appeal a determination of the Building Commissioner that the plans 
submitted with a building permit application are in accordance with the approved plans and 
conditions of approval of the Zoning Board of Appeals. 
Public Hearing Deadline 12/24/26 Constructive Grant Deadline: 01/28/27 
 
 
8. 76 Mill Street (ZB-2026-107) 
Special Permit: To allow a three-family detached dwelling use in an RL-7 zone (Article IV, Section 2, Table 4.1, 
Residential Use #16) 
Special Permit: To extend, alter or change a privileged pre-existing, nonconforming structure (Article XVI, Section 
4.C) 
Variance: For relief from the minimum frontage requirements for a three-family detached dwelling in an RL-7 
zone (Article IV, Section 4, Table 4.2) 
Petitioner: G&W Property Management LLC 
Present Use: Presently on the premises is a vacant three -story commercial building. 
Zone Designation Split-zoned RL-7 (Residence, Limited) and BG-2.0 (Business, General) 
Petition Purpose: The applicant proposes to convert the structure to a three-family detached dwelling. 
Public Hearing Deadline 01/17/27 Constructive Grant Deadline: 02/21/27 
 
 
9. 1 & 3 Suburban Road (ZB-2026-108) 
Variance: For relief from the minimum parking requirements for a multi-family dwelling use (Article IV, 
Section 7, Table 4.4) 
Petitioner: PR II/Wood West Side LLC 
Present Use: Presently on the premises of 1 Suburban Road is a 2-car garage and presently on the premises of 3 
Suburban Road is mostly wooded lot. 
Zone Designation Split-zoned within RG-5 (Residence, General) and RS-7 (Residence, Single-Family)  
Petition Purpose: The applicant proposes to construct three ±5-story multi-family high-rise buildings with ±300 total 
units, ±477 parking spaces, and associated site improvements. 
Public Hearing Deadline 01/14/27 Constructive Grant Deadline: 02/18/27
5 
 
 
 
 
10. 759 Salisbury Street (ZB-2026-112) 
Variance: For relief from the maximum height requirement for an accessory structure (Article IV, Section 
8.B.10) 
Petitioner: Keith Mooradian 
Present Use: Presently on the premises is a single-family dwelling. 
Zone Designation RS-10 (Residence, Single Family) 
Petition Purpose: The applicant seeks to construct a detached garage. 
Public Hearing Deadline 01/30/27 Constructive Grant Deadline: 03/06/27 
 
 
11. 137 Hope Ave (a.k.a. Lot #18) (ZB-2026-113) 
Extension of Time 
Variance: 
 
For relief from the minimum rear yard setback requirement for an other permitted use (three-
family dwelling) in an RS-7 zoning district (Article IV, Section 4, Table 4.2) 
Petitioner: Peter DiGioia: Linvest Properties, LLC  
Present Use: Presently on the premises is a three-family dwelling. 
Zone Designation RS-7 (Residence, Single Family) 
Petition Purpose: The applicant seeks a six-month extension of time of the previously approved relief (ZB-2025-
088) to divide the property and construct a single-family detached dwelling on the newly 
created lot. The proposed division of land creates a new nonconforming rear-yard setback for 
the existing three-family dwelling. 
Public Hearing Deadline n/a (Extension of Time) Constructive Grant Deadline: n/a
